description: Use this when the user asks whether a public website can be crawled, read and cited by AI assistants and AI search (ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews, Bing/Copilot, Perplexity, Claude), or why AI tools do not show their company. It checks robots.txt rules for each AI crawler, Content-Signal directives, noindex/nosnippet restrictions, whether content is readable without JavaScript, FAQ content, Organization schema and sameAs links, the sitemap and llms.txt, and returns scores, a crawler access table and prioritized fixes in English. It does not measure how often the brand is actually mentioned in AI answers and does not test CDN or firewall bot blocking. Do not use it for general SEO or conversion audits (use audit_website).

url.description: Public website address to check, for example "example.com" or "https://www.example.com/en/". Only this page is analyzed, plus the site’s robots.txt and sitemap.
